label: Every CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 originating cause of a thing is a ground of it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, whatever originates a thing's being (CAUSE_OF_BEING_1) is a ground of it under the supplied grounding relation of the lasting-ground premise A2ab. Close to that relation's intended reading (the proximate ground of a thing's coming to be, DISAMB-CAUSAL-SERIES), but not identical: an originating cause gives being at a first moment, a proximate ground of coming to be need not. On the strict esse-giving reading it mildly widens the relation; composed with the A2 derivation, A2c (bf18a0d0) must then hold for the widened relation.
